title: "Distributing and Shipping Your Tool"

# Distributing and Shipping Your Tool

Writing high-performance code is only half the battle. A CLI tool's adoption depends heavily on frictionless installation across diverse package ecosystems and environments.

## Distribution Channels for Rust CLIs

| Distribution Channel | Target Audience | Mechanism |
|---|---|---|
| **`cargo install`** | Rust developers | Compiles from source via `crates.io` |
| **`cargo binstall`** | Rust developers | Downloads pre-compiled release artifacts instantly |
| **Homebrew** | macOS / Linux | Formula pointing to pre-built tarball or source |
| **GitHub Releases** | All platforms | Pre-compiled static binaries in `.tar.gz` and `.zip` |
| **Debian / RPM** | Linux servers | `.deb` and `.rpm` native system packages |
| **Scoop / Chocolatey** | Windows developers | Manifests pulling binary releases |

## Automated Multi-Platform Release with GitHub Actions and `cargo-dist`

`cargo-dist` automates cross-compilation, tarball bundling, shell installer generation, and GitHub Release uploads with a single command:

```bash
cargo install cargo-dist
cargo dist init
```

A sample `.github/workflows/release.yml` matrices the target architectures:

```yaml
name: Release
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  build-release:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        target:
          - x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
          - aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
          - x86_64-apple-darwin
          - aarch64-apple-darwin
          - x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build with cross
        run: |
          cargo install cross
          cross build --target ${{ matrix.target }} --release
```

## Creating Homebrew Formulas

Homebrew users expect to run `brew install myorg/tap/mytool`. An idiomatic Homebrew formula:

```ruby
class Mytool < Formula
  desc "Blazing fast systems developer toolkit"
  homepage "https://github.com/myorg/mytool"
  version "1.0.0"

  on_macos do
    if Hardware::CPU.arm?
      url "https://github.com/myorg/mytool/releases/download/v1.0.0/mytool-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"
      sha256 "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855"
    end
  end

  def install
    bin.install "mytool"
  end

  test do
    system "#{bin}/mytool", "--version"
  end
end
```
